issues.desc: CHK-001 lacks a userSees field. For a doc-only story the userSees should describe what a reader sees when opening the target doc (e.g. a section heading and its key sentences). The intent is clear enough to execute but the checklist format does not meet CLAUDE.md checklist writing standards.
background.md 对话纹理段提到 "B-c9f5 dirty-gate 系列" 但未解释 dirty-gate 系列指哪些 story 或该系列的含义，fresh reader 无法追溯上下文
background.md 触发事件段使用了 "declared artifact声明" / "dirty-gate-policy" / "declared_artifact_changes" 等内部术语，首次出现无展开定义；核心教训（跨 story 叠加漏洞）可从上下文推断，但技术根因细节对全新 reader 不透明

CHK-001 lacks a userSees field. For a doc-only story the userSees should describe what a reader sees when opening the target doc (e.g. a section heading and its key sentences). The intent is clear enough to execute but the checklist format does not meet CLAUDE.md checklist writing standards.
